page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 256 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled as a 2458 GB local SSD, and the instance supports Premium Storage configurations.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the top tier (top 10%) for memory performance, as evidenced by its PassMark memory score and a cached read-only small-block memory bandwidth of 4155.63 GB/sec. Multi-core compute performance is strong, ranking in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and software compilation tasks. Large-block uncached memory read and write speeds operate within the average range. Cryptographic and compression workloads perform well, with strong results in PassMark encryption and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

Given its balanced resource allocation and high-capacity local SSD, the D64ads_v5 offers high resource density suitable for enterprise-grade workloads. It is appropriate for relational databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation pipelines, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores, substantial memory, and fast local storage provides a cost-efficient profile for multi-threaded applications that require consistent, non-burstable performance without the overhead of dedicated GPU hardware.
